text:
dana.sales: ACME POC hitting JSON-mode + function_call breaks: schema ValidationError + occasional truncated JSON. Need quick triage.

eric.eng: Which model/variant and can you paste sanitized payload + failed assistant output?

dana.sales: Model: gptx-4o-hosted. Payload (redacted):
```json
{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"ingest"}],"functions":[{"name":"record_event","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string"},"meta":{"type":"object"}},"required":["id"],"additionalProperties":false}}],"function_call":"auto","mode":"json"}
```

nisha.sre: Traces show 429 spikes at 14:02 -> several upstream resets (ECONNRESET). Those line up with truncated streams.

tom.se: Customer supplied one assistant response: {"name":"record_event","arguments":"{\"id\":\"abc\",\"meta\":\"tags:[]\"}"} - arguments is a JSON string, not an object.

eric.eng: Classic double-serialization. Quick unblock: client-side JSON.parse(arguments) before validation. We'll also push a small canary pre-parser that attempts to parse stringified arguments and emits metric `poc.args_reparsed`.

deploy-bot: Deploying `poc/args-parser-compat` -> canary at 2026-03-21T17:05:00Z.

nisha.sre: Temporarily bumped ACME org rate-limits (200 -> 400 qps) for 2h to reduce mid-stream 429s while they run batches. Monitoring `org.acme_poc.errors` and `ingress.stream_aborts`.

tom.se: After patch + bump customer reports truncation stopped and schema failures dropped; rare residual `additionalProperties` failures remain (~1/3000). Likely ephemeral helper keys.

eric.eng: For POC we can enable opt-in tenant flag `poc.lenient_json_mode` that strips helper keys and normalizes types during validation. Recommend production fix: relax `meta` schema or enumerate fields explicitly.

dana.sales: I'll send ACME the short plan: 1) client parse workaround, 2) rate bump for 2h, 3) canary deployed to auto-parse, 4) opt-in lenient mode available. Thanks team! :rocket:
